description: The full prompt that rebuilds a layer in the chosen framework, with the chosen palette (templates, sections, pages, elements, gradients) or variant (3D scenes, backgrounds, vectors). Follow it as the build brief. Free layers have no limit. A premium layer counts once per UTC day against the caller's daily limit (1 without a key, 3 Free, 30 Pro, none for Lifetime); fetching it again that day is free.

target.description: Framework to build for (see list_targets). Default: one self-contained HTML file.

name: get_prompt
title: Get a layer's build prompt
